subject: CloudStack marketplace voucher batch ingestion + PLG trial extension
messages:
From: Paola Gutierrez <paola@cloudstack.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Voucher batch for CloudStack marketplace — ready for ingestion

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call last week. Per our MOA, we're ready to push the first batch of partner-issued marketplace vouchers to Redwood so they can appear as credits for CloudStack signups via the marketplace flow.

Attached is the CSV export (cloudstack_voucher_upload.csv) with the following columns: voucher_code, amount_usd, expiration, campaign_tag, marketplace_listing_id. We also attached the signed MOA that legal uploaded earlier.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the ingestion window (we're aiming for Wed 3/3 PST)?
- Are there any mapping fields you need us to add (HubSpot contact ID, partner customer ID)?
- We may also request a small set of PLG trial extensions (30-day add-on) that get applied automatically for any voucher redemptions during the first 14 days post-launch — is that something you can enable?

Thanks — cc'ing Aditi from Partner Ops in case she wants to be looped for the ingest.

Cheers,
Paola
Partner Operations | CloudStack
[Attachment: cloudstack_voucher_upload.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: signed_MOA_CloudStack_Redwood.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Paola Gutierrez <paola@cloudstack.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Voucher batch for CloudStack marketplace — ready for ingestion

Paola — thanks for the files and the clear CSV.

We can take the CSV on Wed 3/3 during our 10:00–11:00 PST ingestion window and run it through the partner voucher pipeline. A few notes / requests before we proceed: 

1) Mapping: please add HubSpot contact ID if you have it — we'll map voucher redemptions to contacts for attribution. If you can't provide it, include partner_customer_id and we'll reconcile on our side.

2) Trial extension: we can definitely apply a 30-day trial extension as a promotion tied to those vouchers. That requires a signed addendum to the MOA or an explicit DocuSign toggle from your partner manager team.

3) Ingestion format: your CSV looks fine; we'll run a test ingest on a small subset (50 lines) first and send the ingest receipt back. After you confirm, we'll process the full file.

Next steps from our side (I'll coordinate with Ops):
- Marissa, can you approve the promotional extension and confirm who signs the addendum?
- Camila, can you schedule the small test ingest tomorrow morning and share the receipt?

Paola — if you can reply with the HubSpot IDs (optional) and confirm the signatory for the addendum, we'll move forward.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Paola Gutierrez <paola@cloudstack.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Voucher batch for CloudStack marketplace — ready for ingestion

Jonas / Paola — quick update from the partner enablement side: 

- I reviewed the MOA and the addendum template for promotional extensions. Legal is OK with the one-time 30-day trial extension for the initial campaign; we just need an authorized signature from CloudStack on the addendum.

- Paola — please confirm who will sign (if Aditi will sign, that's fine). Once signed, upload the DocuSign envelope to the Drive link below so Ops has a copy.

- Camila — please run the 50-line test ingest as Jonas suggested. If successful, process the full CSV on 3/3 during the 10:00 PST slot. Make sure to tag redemptions with campaign_tag=CS-MAR-2026 and add HubSpot company ID 9876 when present.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/companies/CS-9876
Drive (MOA + addendum template): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/partner-onboarding/CloudStack-MOA

Paola — when the test ingest is complete, please confirm and we'll return an ingestion receipt and the voucher issuance mapping (voucher_code -> voucher_id in Redwood).

Thanks,
Marissa
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: addendum_template_Promotion-30day.pdf (pdf)]

From: Paola Gutierrez <paola@cloudstack.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditi Rao <aditi@cloudstack.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2026 11:29:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Voucher batch for CloudStack marketplace — ready for ingestion

Thanks — Aditi will sign the addendum today and I uploaded the signed envelope to your Drive link.

We ran the 50-line test this morning and CloudStack Partner Ops reports the ingestion looked good. Attaching the ingestion receipt and a short manifest from our side. Please confirm Redwood's voucher IDs so we can reconcile on our marketplace listing.

[Attachment: voucher_ingest_receipt-20260303.txt (txt)]
[Attachment: cloudstack_voucher_upload.csv (csv) — subset used for test included]

Also, we would like to enable a small PLG trial extension rule: any voucher redeemed during the first 14 days post-listing gets an automatic 30-day extension applied to the new account. We consider this part of the promotional campaign and would like it live with the vouchers.

Let us know if you need any additional approvals.

Best,
Paola
Partner Operations | CloudStack

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Paola Gutierrez <paola@cloudstack.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Voucher batch for CloudStack marketplace — ready for ingestion

Paola — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the signed addendum (we pulled it from Drive).

Status:
- Test ingest succeeded; Ops returned receipt (attached).
- We processed the full batch during the 3/3 10:00 PST window; Redwood voucher IDs have been created and mapped to your voucher_code values. I've exported the mapping and pushed it to the shared Drive folder (under "ingest-outputs/CS-MAR-2026/mapping.csv").
- Promo extension: Legal cleared the addendum and Marissa greenlit the 30-day trial extension for redemptions occurring in the first 14 days following listing. We've enabled the rule in the voucher engine and validated the logic against a staging redemption.

Next steps / outstanding items:
- I'll upload the final mapping CSV to Drive and paste the HubSpot activity link in the HubSpot company record so you can see redemptions attributed to CloudStack.
- Marissa / Rishi: please confirm whether we should automatically issue a top-up credit (one-time $250) to the account owner for the first 20 redemptions as a performance incentive — CloudStack asked about a launch incentive.
- Paola: please confirm if you want Redwood to publish a short launch blurb on our marketplace release notes (we can coordinate copy).

Thanks everyone — nice collaborative rollout.

Jonas
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: voucher_ingest_receipt-20260303.txt]
